items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Two-line change with a clear comment: '# Ensure base table is in aliases.' It matches the existing code's style and is identical to the reference.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing helper query.get_initial_alias() in single_alias, with no duplicated logic, dead code or debug leftovers. Collector and QuerySet.delete are untouched.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Small, targeted change with no new error paths, no magic constants and no swallowed exceptions. get_initial_alias is idempotent and safe to call there.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: Fixes the root cause in SQLDeleteCompiler.single_alias by registering the base alias before counting. Joined deletes still count >1 aliases and keep the subquery, the MySQL override keeps working, and hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).
